notes: Clean pay-when-paid 7 days, 10% retention reduced to 5% at substantial completion (50% released), balance at final; statutory waivers; joint checks; stored materials allowed with insurance.

retainage.reduction_trigger: one-half of accumulated retention released at Substantial Completion
retainage.release_condition: one-half at Substantial Completion of the Subcontract Work; balance at Final Completion and Contractor's receipt of final retention from Owner

anchors.parties.contractor: Meridian Builders, Inc., a California corporation, License No. 1083421
anchors.parties.subcontractor: Ironline Steel Fabricators, Inc., a California corporation, License No. 994817
anchors.parties.owner: The Owner is Bayview Health, a California nonprofit public benefit corporation
anchors.parties.project: The Project is the Bayview Clinic Tenant Improvement at 1400 Embarcadero West, Oakland, California 94607
anchors.governing_law_state: This Subcontract shall be governed by the laws of the State of California
anchors.timing.type: the parties intend this Section 6.2 as a pay-when-paid provision and not as a pay-if-paid provision
anchors.timing.days: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within seven (7) days after Contractor's receipt of the corresponding progress payment from Owner
anchors.timing.agreed_in_writing: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within seven (7) days after Contractor's receipt of the corresponding progress payment from Owner
anchors.retainage.percent_bps: Contractor shall withhold ten percent (10%) of each progress payment as retention
anchors.retainage.reduction_trigger: Upon Substantial Completion of the Subcontract Work, as certified by the Architect, Contractor shall release to Subcontractor one-half of the accumulated retention then held
anchors.retainage.release_condition: The balance of retention shall be released upon Final Completion of the Subcontract Work, acceptance by Owner, and delivery of the closeout documents required by Article 7
anchors.retainage.release_days: within ten (10) days after Contractor's receipt of final retention from Owner
anchors.waivers.conditional_before_progress: a conditional waiver and release upon progress payment, in the form prescribed by California Civil Code Section 8132, for the amount of the current application
anchors.waivers.unconditional_after_payment: unconditional waivers and releases upon progress payment, in the form prescribed by California Civil Code Section 8134
anchors.waivers.lower_tier_required: from Subcontractor and from each of its sub-subcontractors and suppliers of every tier, covering all prior payments
anchors.waivers.statutory_form_required: a conditional waiver and release upon final payment in the form prescribed by California Civil Code Section 8136
anchors.offsets.joint_check: make any payment under this Subcontract by check payable jointly to Subcontractor and any sub-subcontractor, supplier or laborer
anchors.offsets.backcharge_setoff: Contractor may perform the obligation and deduct the reasonable cost, plus ten percent (10%) for overhead, from amounts due Subcontractor
anchors.offsets.withhold_defective: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount reasonably necessary to protect Contractor and Owner from loss on account of defective work not remedied
anchors.stored_materials: Contractor shall include in progress payments the value of fabricated steel and other materials delivered and suitably stored at the Project site
